daily_market.title: A Day at the Market
daily_market.author: Antigravity
en: It is a bright Saturday morning. The sun shines in the blue sky. Anna wakes up early. She feels happy because today is market day. Anna needs fresh food for her home. She puts on her favorite blue coat and walks to the local market. The market is very close to her apartment. Many people are on the street. She sees the big brown gate of the market. She hears many sounds. People talk and laugh. There is music too. Anna walks inside the gate. She smells fresh air and green plants. She has a big empty bag in her hand. She is ready to buy many good things. Anna looks at the stalls. She smiles at a kind man. The man stands near his stall. He has red apples and big yellow lemons today.

Anna walks to the man. She says hello to him. The man smiles back at her. He says hello to Anna too. Anna looks at the red apples. They look very sweet and delicious. She asks the man about the price. She points to the apples with her hand. The man says the price is low today. Anna likes the price. She takes five red apples. She puts the apples in her bag. She wants to buy more food for the week. She looks at the bright yellow lemons. They are very fresh. She decides to take four lemons too. She puts them in her bag with the apples. The man says thank you to Anna. Anna says thank you back. She feels good about the fresh fruit. She is happy with her first purchase.

Anna walks to the next stall. A woman sells green vegetables here. There are fresh carrots and long green cucumbers. The carrots look very clean and crunchy. Anna needs carrots for her soup. She likes to make soup for her lunch. She talks to the woman at the stall. She asks if the carrots are sweet. The woman nods her head and says yes. The woman says the carrots come from a farm today. Anna chooses six big carrots. She puts them in her bag. She sees the long green cucumbers too. They look cool and fresh. She wants two cucumbers for a salad. She asks the price again. The woman gives her the total price. Anna takes her money from her small wallet. She pays the woman. She feels very happy with her day.

Anna walks further into the busy market. The sun is now high and warm. She sees a small stall with many colorful vegetables. There are round red tomatoes and big purple onions. Anna loves to cook healthy meals at home. She stops in front of the stall. A young man works there. He wears a white apron. Anna says hello to him. The man smiles and says hello back. Anna asks for some tomatoes. She points at the bright red ones. The man picks up three big tomatoes for her. They are very firm and look perfect for a salad. Anna is happy with the tomatoes. She asks the man if he has onions too. The man shows her a basket of fresh purple onions. He tells her the onions are from his garden.

Anna likes the purple onions very much. She chooses four onions for her kitchen. She thinks about the soup she wants to make later today. The man puts the onions in a small paper bag. He gives the bag to Anna. Anna takes out her wallet to pay for the vegetables. She has some coins and small bills inside. She counts the money carefully and gives it to the man. The man says thank you to Anna. Anna smiles and says thank you too. She puts the paper bag into her large shopping bag. Now her bag is getting very full. She feels strong and healthy. It is a very good day to buy food at the market. Anna looks at the other stalls near her.

The market is full of life and happy energy today. Anna walks slowly to the next stall. This stall sells fresh bread and green herbs. She smells the delicious bread from far away. She feels hungry now. She looks at a long loaf of bread. The crust is brown and very crispy. She asks the seller for the price. The seller is an old woman with a kind face. She tells Anna the price in a soft voice. Anna thinks the price is fair for such fresh bread. She buys the bread and some green herbs for her soup. She puts everything in her bag. Her bag is now very heavy but she is very happy. She has all the things she needs for her healthy lunch at home.

Anna walks further into the busy market. She feels very happy because the sun is bright today. There are many colors everywhere. She sees a big table with many green things. She walks to the table and looks at the plants. There are fresh leaves and small green herbs. The seller is a young woman with a red hat. She smiles at Anna and says hello. Anna says hello and asks about the herbs. She wants to make a nice dinner for her friend. The woman shows her some green mint and parsley. They smell very fresh and clean. Anna likes the smell a lot. She asks for two bunches of mint. The woman nods and picks two big green bunches for Anna. She puts them on the table carefully.

Anna likes the mint very much. She touches the soft green leaves. The woman says the herbs are from her farm. Anna feels happy to support the local farm. She asks the woman how much they cost. The woman says a small price for the fresh herbs. Anna agrees and takes some money from her small purse. She gives the money to the woman. The woman says thank you and puts the mint in a clean bag. Anna takes the bag and puts it in her basket. She feels ready for her cooking. She likes the market because people are kind and helpful here. She wants to see what else she can find for her healthy lunch at home today.

The sun is now very warm on her face. Anna moves to the next stall. This place sells sweet fruit. She sees many yellow lemons and big green apples. The fruits look very bright under the sun. She needs some lemons for her water. A man stands behind the fruit. He wears a blue shirt and says good morning to her. Anna says good morning. She asks the man for three lemons. The man picks three nice yellow lemons. They feel heavy and smooth in his hand. He gives them to Anna. Anna pays the man with some coins. She is happy because she has all her items now. The bag is full and she decides to walk home slowly. It is a very good day.

Anna walks home with her heavy basket. The path is quiet and the sky is very blue. She thinks about her meal tonight. She wants to cook a healthy dinner for her best friend. The bag of mint is on top. She can smell the fresh herbs. It smells like a sunny garden in the spring. Anna feels calm and peaceful. She walks past a small park with many trees. A little dog runs near her. It looks happy to see her. Anna smiles at the dog and keeps walking. She thinks about the fresh lemons too. She wants to put them in her cold water at home. The market is a special place for her. She likes to meet nice people there. The day is perfect and her basket is full of good food.

She arrives at her small house. The door is open a little bit. She walks inside and puts the basket on the kitchen table. Everything looks very good. She takes the green mint out of the bag. It is very green and clean. She puts the mint in a glass of water. Then she takes the yellow lemons. She cuts one lemon and puts it in her drink. The water tastes very fresh now. Anna sits on her chair and rests for a moment. She is tired but she feels very happy. Her home is small and clean. She likes her kitchen because it is bright today. She prepares a bowl for her vegetables. She washes the green herbs with cold water. Everything is ready for her dinner.

The afternoon goes by very fast. Anna starts to cook the dinner. She uses the fresh herbs from the market. The kitchen smells great now. She is ready for her friend. The doorbell rings and she opens the door. Her friend stands there with a big smile. They say hello and hug each other. Anna shows her friend the fresh dinner on the table. Her friend looks at the food and likes it a lot. They sit down and eat together. They talk about their day and laugh a lot. It is a very nice evening for both of them. Anna thinks about the market again. She is glad she goes there today. It is a wonderful day with good food and a dear friend.

Anna and her friend finish the delicious dinner. They eat all the vegetables and the fresh fruit. The plates are empty now. Her friend says thank you for the food. It is very tasty and healthy. Anna smiles and says it is my pleasure. They drink some tea and sit near the window. The sky is dark and the stars are bright. It is a quiet night in the city. Anna thinks about the market one more time. She feels happy because her friend likes the dinner. They talk about the next weekend. Maybe they go to the market again together. Anna enjoys the time with her friend. Good food and good company make her very happy. She loves her simple life and her small, cozy home.

The friend puts on a coat and says goodbye. Anna walks to the door with her. They say goodnight and talk about the next meeting. Anna closes the door and goes back to the kitchen. She sees the empty basket on the table. It is the same basket from the local market. She cleans the kitchen and washes the dishes. The kitchen is tidy now. She feels relaxed after a long and productive day. She walks to the living room and sits on the soft sofa. She remembers the colorful stalls at the market. She remembers the kind man with the red apples. Life is good when she buys fresh food. She is ready for bed and waits for the new day tomorrow.

She turns off the lights in her house. Everything is very quiet. Anna lies in her bed and closes her eyes. She dreams about the green vegetables and the bright yellow lemons. The market is a beautiful place. She wants to go back again soon. She likes the colors and the happy sounds of the people. She thinks about the fresh mint in the water. It tastes so clean and natural. She is lucky to have this local market near her house. Anna falls asleep with a small smile on her face. Tomorrow is a new day with new chances. She is thankful for her healthy food and her warm bed. She sleeps peacefully in the soft moonlight. The day is finally over.
tr: Parlak bir Cumartesi sabahı. Güneş mavi gökyüzünde parlıyor. Anna erken uyanıyor. Mutlu çünkü bugün pazar günü. Anna'nın evi için taze yiyeceğe ihtiyacı var. En sevdiği mavi montunu giyiyor ve yerel pazara yürüyor. Pazar, dairesine çok yakın. Sokakta birçok insan var. Pazarın büyük kahverengi kapısını görüyor. Birçok ses duyuyor. İnsanlar konuşuyor ve gülüyor. Müzik de var. Anna kapıdan içeri yürüyor. Taze hava ve yeşil bitkiler kokuyor. Elinde büyük boş bir çantası var. Birçok güzel şey almaya hazır. Anna tezgahlara bakıyor. Nazik bir adama gülümsüyor. Adam tezgahının yanında duruyor. Bugün kırmızı elmaları ve büyük sarı limonları var.

Anna adama doğru yürüyor. Ona merhaba diyor. Adam ona gülümseyerek karşılık veriyor. O da Anna'ya merhaba diyor. Anna kırmızı elmalara bakıyor. Çok tatlı ve lezzetli görünüyorlar. Adama fiyatı soruyor. Eliyle elmaları işaret ediyor. Adam bugün fiyatın düşük olduğunu söylüyor. Anna fiyatı beğeniyor. Beş tane kırmızı elma alıyor. Elmaları çantasına koyuyor. Hafta için daha fazla yiyecek almak istiyor. Parlak sarı limonlara bakıyor. Çok tazeler. Dört tane de limon almaya karar veriyor. Onları elmalarla birlikte çantasına koyuyor. Adam Anna'ya teşekkür ediyor. Anna da ona teşekkür ediyor. Taze meyveler için kendini iyi hissediyor. İlk alışverişinden memnun.

Anna bir sonraki tezgaha yürüyor. Bir kadın burada yeşil sebzeler satıyor. Taze havuçlar ve uzun yeşil salatalıklar var. Havuçlar çok temiz ve kıtır görünüyor. Anna'nın çorbası için havuçlara ihtiyacı var. Öğle yemeği için çorba yapmayı seviyor. Tezgahtaki kadınla konuşuyor. Havuçların tatlı olup olmadığını soruyor. Kadın başını sallıyor ve evet diyor. Kadın havuçların bugün çiftlikten geldiğini söylüyor. Anna altı büyük havuç seçiyor. Onları çantasına koyuyor. Uzun yeşil salatalıkları da görüyor. Serin ve taze görünüyorlar. Salata için iki salatalık istiyor. Tekrar fiyatı soruyor. Kadın ona toplam fiyatı veriyor. Anna küçük cüzdanından parasını çıkarıyor. Kadına ödeme yapıyor. Gününden dolayı çok mutlu hissediyor.

Anna hareketli pazarın içlerine doğru yürüyor. Güneş artık yüksekte ve sıcak. Birçok renkli sebzenin olduğu küçük bir tezgah görüyor. Yuvarlak kırmızı domatesler ve büyük mor soğanlar var. Anna evde sağlıklı yemekler pişirmeyi seviyor. Tezgahın önünde duruyor. Orada genç bir adam çalışıyor. Üzerinde beyaz bir önlük var. Anna ona merhaba diyor. Adam gülümsüyor ve karşılık veriyor. Anna biraz domates istiyor. Parlak kırmızı olanları gösteriyor. Adam onun için üç büyük domates seçiyor. Çok sertler ve salata için mükemmel görünüyorlar. Anna domateslerden memnun. Adama soğan olup olmadığını soruyor. Adam ona bir sepet taze mor soğan gösteriyor. Soğanların kendi bahçesinden olduğunu söylüyor.

Anna mor soğanları çok seviyor. Mutfağı için dört soğan seçiyor. Bugün daha sonra yapmak istediği çorbayı düşünüyor. Adam soğanları küçük bir kağıt torbaya koyuyor. Torbayı Anna'ya veriyor. Anna sebzelerin parasını ödemek için cüzdanını çıkarıyor. İçinde biraz bozuk para ve küçük kağıt paralar var. Parayı dikkatlice sayıyor ve adama veriyor. Adam Anna'ya teşekkür ediyor. Anna gülümsüyor ve o da teşekkür ediyor. Kağıt torbayı büyük alışveriş çantasına koyuyor. Şimdi çantası çok doluyor. Kendini güçlü ve sağlıklı hissediyor. Pazardan yiyecek almak için çok güzel bir gün. Anna yakındaki diğer tezgahlara bakıyor.

Pazar bugün hayat ve mutlu enerji ile dolu. Anna yavaşça bir sonraki tezgaha yürüyor. Bu tezgahta taze ekmek ve yeşil otlar satılıyor. Lezzetli ekmek kokusunu uzaktan alıyor. Şimdi acıktığını hissediyor. Uzun bir ekmeğe bakıyor. Kabuğu kahverengi ve çok çıtır. Satıcıya fiyatı soruyor. Satıcı, nazik yüzlü yaşlı bir kadın. Anna'ya fiyatı yumuşak bir sesle söylüyor. Anna, böylesine taze bir ekmek için fiyatın uygun olduğunu düşünüyor. Ekmeği ve çorbası için biraz yeşil ot alıyor. Her şeyi çantasına koyuyor. Çantası şimdi çok ağır ama o çok mutlu. Evdeki sağlıklı öğle yemeği için ihtiyacı olan her şeye sahip.

Anna yoğun pazarın içine doğru yürür. Bugün güneş parlak olduğu için kendini çok mutlu hisseder. Her yer çok renkli. Birçok yeşil şeyin olduğu büyük bir masa görür. Masaya doğru yürür ve bitkilere bakar. Taze yapraklar ve küçük yeşil otlar vardır. Satıcı kırmızı şapkalı genç bir kadındır. Anna'ya gülümser ve merhaba der. Anna merhaba der ve otlar hakkında soru sorar. Arkadaşı için güzel bir akşam yemeği yapmak ister. Kadın ona biraz yeşil nane ve maydanoz gösterir. Çok taze ve temiz kokuyorlar. Anna kokuyu çok sever. İki demet nane ister. Kadın başını sallar ve Anna için iki büyük yeşil demet seçer. Onları dikkatlice masanın üzerine koyar.

Anna naneyi çok sever. Yumuşak yeşil yapraklara dokunur. Kadın otların kendi çiftliğinden geldiğini söyler. Anna yerel çiftliği desteklediği için mutlu olur. Kadına ne kadar olduklarını sorar. Kadın taze otlar için küçük bir fiyat söyler. Anna kabul eder ve küçük çantasından biraz para çıkarır. Parayı kadına verir. Kadın teşekkür eder ve naneyi temiz bir torbaya koyar. Anna torbayı alır ve sepetine koyar. Yemek yapmaya hazır hisseder. İnsanlar nazik ve yardımsever olduğu için pazarı sever. Bugün evde yapacağı sağlıklı öğle yemeği için başka ne bulabileceğini görmek ister.

Güneş artık yüzünde çok sıcak. Anna bir sonraki tezgaha geçer. Burası tatlı meyveler satıyor. Birçok sarı limon ve büyük yeşil elma görür. Meyveler güneşin altında çok parlak görünür. Suyu için biraz limona ihtiyacı var. Bir adam meyvelerin arkasında durur. Mavi bir gömlek giyer ve ona günaydın der. Anna günaydın der. Adamdan üç limon ister. Adam üç güzel sarı limon seçer. Elinde ağır ve pürüzsüz dururlar. Onları Anna'ya verir. Anna adama biraz bozuk para ile ödeme yapar. Tüm malzemeleri olduğu için mutludur. Çanta doludur ve yavaşça eve yürümeye karar verir. Çok güzel bir gün.

Anna ağır sepetiyle eve yürüyor. Yol sessiz ve gökyüzü çok mavi. Bu akşamki yemeğini düşünüyor. En iyi arkadaşı için sağlıklı bir akşam yemeği pişirmek istiyor. Nane çantası en üstte duruyor. Taze otların kokusunu alabiliyor. Baharda güneşli bir bahçe gibi kokuyor. Anna sakin ve huzurlu hissediyor. Birçok ağacın olduğu küçük bir parkın önünden geçiyor. Küçük bir köpek ona doğru koşuyor. Onu gördüğü için mutlu görünüyor. Anna köpeğe gülümsüyor ve yürümeye devam ediyor. Taze limonları da düşünüyor. Onları evde soğuk suyuna koymak istiyor. Pazar onun için özel bir yer. Orada iyi insanlarla tanışmayı seviyor. Gün mükemmel ve sepeti iyi yiyeceklerle dolu.

Küçük evine varıyor. Kapı biraz açık. İçeri giriyor ve sepeti mutfak masasına koyuyor. Her şey çok iyi görünüyor. Yeşil naneyi çantadan çıkarıyor. Çok yeşil ve temiz. Naneyi bir bardak suya koyuyor. Sonra sarı limonları alıyor. Bir limonu kesiyor ve içeceğine koyuyor. Su şimdi çok taze tadıyor. Anna sandalyesine oturuyor ve bir an dinleniyor. Yorgun ama kendini çok mutlu hissediyor. Evi küçük ve temiz. Mutfağını seviyor çünkü bugün çok aydınlık. Sebzeleri için bir kase hazırlıyor. Yeşil otları soğuk suyla yıkıyor. Akşam yemeği için her şey hazır.

Öğleden sonra çok hızlı geçiyor. Anna akşam yemeğini pişirmeye başlıyor. Pazardan aldığı taze otları kullanıyor. Mutfak şimdi harika kokuyor. Arkadaşı için hazır. Kapı zili çalıyor ve kapıyı açıyor. Arkadaşı büyük bir gülümsemeyle orada duruyor. Merhaba diyorlar ve birbirlerine sarılıyorlar. Anna arkadaşına masadaki taze yemeği gösteriyor. Arkadaşı yemeğe bakıyor ve onu çok beğeniyor. Oturuyorlar ve birlikte yemek yiyorlar. Günleri hakkında konuşuyorlar ve çok gülüyorlar. İkisi için de çok güzel bir akşam. Anna tekrar pazarı düşünüyor. Bugün oraya gittiği için memnun. İyi yemekler ve sevgili bir arkadaşla harika bir gün.

Anna ve arkadaşı lezzetli akşam yemeğini bitirirler. Tüm sebzeleri ve taze meyveleri yerler. Tabaklar şimdi boş. Arkadaşı yemek için teşekkür eder. Yemek çok lezzetli ve sağlıklı. Anna gülümser ve rica ederim der. Biraz çay içerler ve pencerenin yanında otururlar. Gökyüzü karanlık ve yıldızlar parlak. Şehirde sessiz bir gece. Anna bir kez daha pazarı düşünür. Arkadaşı yemeği beğendiği için mutlu hisseder. Gelecek hafta sonu hakkında konuşurlar. Belki tekrar birlikte pazara giderler. Anna arkadaşıyla vakit geçirmekten hoşlanır. İyi yemek ve iyi arkadaşlık onu çok mutlu eder. Basit hayatını ve küçük, rahat evini sever.

Arkadaşı paltosunu giyer ve hoşça kal der. Anna onunla kapıya kadar yürür. İyi geceler dilerler ve bir sonraki buluşma hakkında konuşurlar. Anna kapıyı kapatır ve mutfağa geri döner. Masanın üzerindeki boş sepeti görür. Bu yerel pazardan gelen aynı sepettir. Mutfağı temizler ve bulaşıkları yıkar. Mutfak artık düzenli. Uzun ve verimli bir günden sonra rahatlamış hisseder. Oturma odasına yürür ve yumuşak kanepeye oturur. Pazardaki renkli tezgahları hatırlar. Kırmızı elmalı nazik adamı hatırlar. Taze yiyecekler aldığında hayat güzeldir. Yatağa hazırdır ve yarınki yeni günü bekler.

Evindeki ışıkları kapatır. Her yer çok sessiz. Anna yatağına uzanır ve gözlerini kapatır. Yeşil sebzeler ve parlak sarı limonlar hakkında hayaller kurar. Pazar güzel bir yerdir. Yakında tekrar gitmek ister. İnsanların renklerini ve mutlu seslerini sever. Sudaki taze naneyi düşünür. Tadı çok temiz ve doğal. Evinin yakınında bu yerel pazar olduğu için şanslı. Anna yüzünde küçük bir gülümsemeyle uykuya dalar. Yarın yeni fırsatlarla dolu yeni bir gün. Sağlıklı yemeği ve sıcak yatağı için minnettardır. Yumuşak ay ışığında huzurla uyur. Gün nihayet bitti.

daily_cafe.title: Coffee and Conversation
daily_cafe.author: Antigravity
en: The morning sun shines through the window of the cafe. The air smells like fresh coffee beans. It is a quiet day. Tom walks into the shop. He likes this place very much. He sees a table near the glass window. He sits down on a comfortable wooden chair. A friendly woman walks to his table. She works at the cafe. She smiles at him. The woman says, Hello, welcome to our shop. What do you want to drink today? Tom looks at the large menu on the wall. He thinks for a moment. He feels very happy to be here. He likes the warm atmosphere of the room. He looks at the woman and speaks clearly. He says, Hello, I want a hot cup of black coffee, please.

The woman nods her head. She writes his order on a small notepad. She asks, Do you want anything to eat with your coffee? Tom looks at the glass display case. He sees many delicious snacks. There are brown chocolate cookies and sweet apple muffins. He likes muffins very much. They look fresh and soft. He points at a large apple muffin. He tells the woman, Yes, please. I want one apple muffin too. The woman smiles again. She says, That is a good choice. Our apple muffins are very popular here. Please wait for a few minutes. Your coffee and muffin are coming soon. Tom thanks her. He takes out his phone and reads the news. He enjoys the quiet time.

The cafe is calm. Other people talk quietly at different tables. A man drinks tea near the door. A woman reads a book in the corner. Tom likes to watch the street. People walk past the cafe on the sidewalk. Some people drink coffee as they walk to work. Tom feels relaxed in his seat. He waits for his breakfast. After a short time, the woman comes back. She carries a tray in her hands. The hot coffee smells strong and good. The muffin is warm and smells like cinnamon. She puts the tray on the table. She says, Here is your coffee and your muffin. Enjoy your snack, sir. Tom smiles at her. He says, Thank you very much. This looks very delicious.

Tom looks at his hot coffee. The steam rises slowly from the cup. It is a dark, warm drink. He likes the smell of coffee very much. He picks up the spoon and adds a little sugar. He moves the spoon in circles inside the cup. The sound is soft and gentle. Tom takes a small sip. It tastes very good. He is happy because the coffee is not too hot. He puts the spoon on the small plate. The cafe is a very calm place to sit and drink. He feels relaxed after a long morning at work. Outside, the sun shines brightly on the street. He watches the people walk past the window. It is a nice day for a break.

He looks at his large apple muffin. It is golden brown and smells sweet. He picks up a small piece with his hand. The muffin is soft and fresh. He takes a bite and smiles. The muffin tastes like apples and cinnamon. He likes the taste very much. It is the perfect snack for his coffee. He thinks that the cafe has the best food in the city. He eats slowly and enjoys every bite. The atmosphere in the shop is cozy and quiet. A soft song plays on the radio in the corner. Tom likes this music. He closes his eyes for a moment. He feels very peaceful while he eats his breakfast at the wooden table.

The woman walks by his table again. She stops and asks if he likes his food. Tom looks at her and nods his head. He speaks to her with a big smile. Everything is perfect, he says. The coffee is very hot and the muffin is very delicious. The woman is happy to hear this. She tells him to enjoy the rest of his day. Tom continues to eat his snack. He reads a message on his phone. He does not want to leave the cafe yet. He likes the smell of the room and the quiet sounds. He drinks the last drop of his coffee. He feels full and satisfied. This is a very good morning for Tom.

Tom finishes his muffin. He feels very good now. He looks around the cafe. Many people sit at the tables. Some people read books. Others talk to their friends quietly. A man near the window drinks tea. He has a small piece of chocolate cake. The cafe is a happy place for everyone. Tom watches a cat walk near the door. The cat looks soft and gray. It stops and sits on the floor. Tom likes cats. He smiles at the small animal. The sun comes through the window and makes the room warm. Tom takes his phone and checks the time. It is ten o'clock in the morning. He has more time for his coffee. He decides to order one more drink because he enjoys the cozy atmosphere.

The woman walks near the counter again. Tom waves his hand to call her. She walks to his table with a friendly face. Tom speaks to her clearly. He says, I want one more coffee, please. She nods and says, Yes, of course. Do you want sugar or milk in your coffee? Tom thinks for a moment. He says, I want a little milk, please. The woman smiles and walks to the coffee machine. She works fast. Tom hears the sound of the machine. It is a loud but familiar sound. He waits for his fresh cup. He looks at the menu on the wall. He sees many good things on the list. He thinks about a cookie for his next visit to this nice place.

The woman brings the hot cup to his table. She puts it down carefully. The milk makes the coffee look light brown. It smells very creamy and sweet. Tom says, Thank you very much. She answers, You are very welcome. Have a nice morning. Tom takes the cup with both hands. It feels warm and nice. He takes a small sip. It is perfect. The milk makes the drink smooth. He looks out of the window again. The street is busy now. Many cars drive past the shop. People walk fast to their offices. Tom feels lucky because he sits in this quiet cafe. He reads his news on his phone. He drinks his coffee and stays in his seat for a long time.

Tom finishes his drink slowly. The cup is empty now. He feels very relaxed in this comfortable chair. The shop is still busy, but it feels peaceful. A new person enters the cafe. It is a man with a red coat. He walks to the counter and talks to the woman. Tom watches them for a minute. The man orders a cold glass of juice and a big sandwich. Tom feels a little hungry too. He looks at the glass display case near the counter. He sees many tasty snacks. There are chocolate muffins, fruit pies, and small bread rolls. Everything looks fresh and delicious. Tom likes this neighborhood spot very much. He decides to stay for a little more food. He stands up and walks to the counter to look closely at the food.

The woman at the counter sees Tom. She says hello with a big smile. Tom looks at the display case again. He wants a snack for his second coffee. He points to a small biscuit. It looks very crunchy and sweet. Tom asks the woman, Is this a butter biscuit? The woman says, Yes, it is. Do you want one? Tom answers, Yes, please. I want one biscuit and a small bowl of fruit. The woman takes the biscuit with a clean napkin. She puts some fresh red apples in a white bowl. She smiles and gives the food to Tom. Tom says, Thank you so much. He pays for his snack with his card. The machine makes a beep sound. The transaction is very fast and easy today.

Tom goes back to his favorite table. He puts his bowl and the biscuit on the wooden table. He feels happy with his choice. He takes a small bite of the biscuit. It is crunchy and tastes like butter. He eats the fresh apples slowly. The fruit is cold and sweet. He thinks about his day. He has no work today. It is a good day for a nice break. He drinks the last drop of his second coffee. He feels full and satisfied now. The cafe is a very nice place for a morning snack. He looks at the clock on the wall again. It is eleven o'clock. Tom decides to leave soon. He cleans his table and puts his napkin in the bin. He is ready to walk home now.

Tom stands up slowly. He picks up his empty bowl and the used napkin. The cafe is very quiet now. He walks to the small bin near the door. He puts his trash inside the bin carefully. Then, he looks at the woman behind the counter. She is very friendly. Tom says, Everything is delicious today. Thank you for the snack. The woman smiles back at him. She says, You are welcome. Please come back again soon. Tom nods and feels good. He likes the friendly people here. It is a nice neighborhood. He feels happy because he has a good place to rest. He walks to the front door and opens it. A soft wind blows on his face. The sun is bright in the blue sky.

He steps onto the street. The weather is very nice. Tom walks along the sidewalk with a smile on his face. He remembers the taste of the fresh fruit and the sweet biscuit. The coffee makes him feel awake and calm. He walks past the park. Many children play with their toys on the green grass. Tom stops for a moment to watch them. He feels very relaxed today. He loves the simple things in his life. He thinks about his next visit to the cafe. He wants to bring his friend next time. Maybe they can drink tea and talk about their plans. Tom starts to walk to his house again. He is ready for a new and happy afternoon.

Tom finally reaches his house. He opens his door and goes inside. His house is cool and comfortable. He hangs his coat on the hook. He feels very glad about his nice morning. The neighborhood cafe is his favorite spot in the whole city. It is a place for good coffee and quiet moments. He plans to go there again next Saturday. He sits in his favorite chair at home. He closes his eyes for a short nap. He feels very peaceful. Life is simple and very good today. He enjoys the quiet silence in his house. The day continues in a beautiful way. Tom is a very lucky man. He sleeps for a little while and dreams about a big, sweet chocolate muffin.

daily_taxi.title: The Taxi Ride
daily_taxi.author: Antigravity
en: It is a sunny morning in the city. Tom stands on the sidewalk. He has a big blue bag. He wants to go to the train station. It is far from his house. Tom looks at the busy street. Many cars go by, but there is no bus. He sees a yellow taxi. He raises his hand to stop the car. The driver sees Tom and stops the taxi in front of him. Tom smiles and walks to the taxi door. The driver opens the window. Tom asks, Hello, can you take me to the train station, please? The driver nods his head and says, Yes, I can take you there. Please get in. Tom opens the back door and sits inside the car. He is happy because the taxi is clean and comfortable.

The driver turns to Tom. He asks, Where is the train station exactly? Tom answers, It is near the big park on Green Street. The driver starts the engine. The car moves slowly into the traffic. Tom looks out the window at the tall buildings and the people. He likes the city. The driver drives carefully. He stops at a red light. Tom checks his watch. He has time for his train. The driver talks to Tom. The weather is very nice today, he says. Tom agrees. Yes, it is a beautiful day for a trip. I am going to see my family today. The driver smiles. That is very nice, he says. They continue to drive through the busy city streets together.

The taxi turns left onto a small road. The park is on the right side. Tom points at the park. He says, See that large green park? The train station is just behind it. The driver sees the station building. He says, I see the station now. Do you want me to stop at the front door? Tom replies, Yes, please stop there. It is perfect. The driver parks the car near the entrance. The street is quiet here. Tom reaches for his wallet in his pocket. He is ready to pay the driver for the ride. The taxi is a fast way to travel in the city. Tom likes the service. He looks at the driver and says, Thank you for the ride. The driver replies, You are very welcome. Have a safe trip today.

Tom opens his big blue bag to find his wallet. He takes out some money for the driver. The taxi ride is fast and very comfortable today. Tom looks at the driver and gives him the money. The driver smiles and says thank you to Tom. Tom says it is a good price for the ride. He feels very happy because he is now at the station. He opens the car door and steps out onto the sidewalk. He stands near the big building of the train station. The sun is bright in the sky today. Tom waves at the driver. The driver waves back at him. It is a good morning for a trip to visit family. Tom walks slowly toward the entrance of the station with his heavy blue bag.

The driver waits for a moment. He watches Tom walk to the station entrance. Then, he puts the car in gear and drives away. Tom looks at the station clock on the wall. He has thirty minutes before the train leaves. He walks to the ticket desk. A friendly man stands behind the desk. Tom smiles and says hello to him. He asks for a ticket to the next city. The man gives him a paper ticket. Tom puts the ticket in his pocket. He feels good because he has time now. He walks to a small shop inside the station. He buys a cold water and a small snack. He sits on a bench and waits for his train to arrive soon.

The train station is full of many people today. Some people read books and others talk on their phones. Tom sits on the bench and looks at his bag. He checks his watch again. The time passes very quickly now. He stands up and walks to the platform. The train comes to the station with a loud sound. It stops in front of the platform. The doors open for the people. Tom walks into the train with his bag. He finds a seat near the window. He looks out of the window at the city. He thinks about the taxi driver. It is a nice day to travel. The train starts to move away from the station. Tom is ready for his long trip today.

Tom sits by the window. The train moves fast now. He looks at the green trees and the houses outside. The city is big, but he likes it. He takes a book from his blue bag and reads it. He feels relaxed and happy. The train is very quiet today. A woman sits in the seat next to him. She smiles at Tom. Tom says hello to her. The woman has a red hat. They do not talk more. Tom looks out the window again. He sees the sun over the mountains. The world is beautiful today. He thinks about his family in the other city. They are waiting for him. It is a long way, but the train is fast and comfortable. He likes this morning trip very much.

The train stops at a small station for a few minutes. Some people leave the train and some new people come inside. It is busy for a short time. Tom looks at his bag. He wants to make sure his things are safe. He has his ticket and his wallet in his pocket. He is happy that he is on the train now. He remembers the taxi driver from earlier. The driver is a nice man. Tom likes to meet good people. He drinks his cold water and eats his small snack. The snack is tasty. He watches the people on the platform. A child waves at the train. Tom waves back. Life is good and simple. He feels ready to see his family soon.

The train starts to move again. The wheels make a soft sound on the tracks. Tom closes his eyes for a little nap. He is a little tired after his walk in the station. He sleeps for a short time. When he wakes up, he looks at his watch. He has one hour before he arrives at the next city. He stands up to stretch his legs. The train is smooth. He walks to the back of the carriage to look at the view. He sees a long river and many farm fields. The trip is a nice break from his work. He goes back to his seat and waits. He is excited to see his parents. The train travels fast across the land.

The train arrives at the station in the city. Tom takes his bag and walks to the door. He steps onto the busy platform. Many people walk quickly here. Tom looks for a taxi. He walks out of the station and sees a long line of yellow cars. The sun is very bright today. He feels happy and energetic. He finds the first taxi in the line. The driver is an older man with a blue shirt. Tom walks to the car and says hello. He asks the driver for a ride to his house. The driver smiles and nods his head. Tom puts his heavy bag in the back. He sits in the car and closes the door. He feels comfortable now. He looks out of the window at the busy city streets.

The taxi starts to drive away from the station. Tom looks at the map on his phone. He needs to give the driver the right directions. He tells the driver the name of the street. Tom says, Please turn left at the next big corner. The driver says, Okay, I go left now. The car moves slowly because there is much traffic. Tom sees many big shops and tall buildings. He likes to look at the people on the sidewalk. Some people walk their dogs. Others talk on their phones. Tom enjoys the view. He watches the traffic lights change from green to red. He is very calm. He does not mind the slow traffic. He knows he will be at his family home soon.

They turn onto a small street with many trees. Tom tells the driver to turn right at the blue house. The driver says, Is it the house with the big garden? Tom says, Yes, that is my home. The taxi slows down and stops right in front of the gate. Tom looks at the meter. He takes his money from his wallet. He pays the driver and says thank you. The driver smiles and says, You are welcome. Have a nice day. Tom takes his bag and steps out of the taxi. He stands on the sidewalk and looks at his house. The windows are open and he hears music. He feels very happy. He walks to the front door and rings the bell.

The front door opens slowly. Tom sees his mother. She wears a colorful apron and holds a wooden spoon. She smiles very wide. Tom says, Hello Mom, I am home! She puts down the spoon and gives him a big hug. It is a very warm hug. She asks, How is your long trip today? Tom says, It is good. The taxi ride is very nice. The driver is very kind to me. My bag is heavy, but I am happy now. Tom walks into the house with his heavy bag. The house smells like fresh bread and sweet fruit. He feels hungry. His mother points to the kitchen. She says, Lunch is on the table. Come and eat with me. Tom smiles and follows her to the kitchen.

They sit together at the big wooden table. The table has plates, forks, and glasses. Tom tells his mother about the busy city. He says, The city is very big and loud. I see many shops and tall buildings on the way. I see many people too. The taxi driver helps me find the way to our street. I like the view from the window. Everything is very green and pretty near our house. His mother listens to him and nods. She gives him some soup in a blue bowl. The soup is very hot and tasty. Tom drinks it slowly. He feels tired but very calm. He is finally home after a long journey. This is the best feeling in the world for him.

After lunch, Tom goes to his room. He puts his bag on the floor. He opens the window and lets the fresh air inside. He hears the birds in the garden. He looks at his bed. It is soft and white. He thinks about the taxi ride again. He is glad he gets home safely. He takes off his shoes and sits on the chair. He reads a book for a short time. He feels very quiet and peaceful in his home. He loves his family and his house. He closes his eyes for a nap. He is a happy man. Everything is perfect today. He sleeps soundly while the sun shines through the window. The house is very quiet and safe for him now.

daily_hotel.title: Checking In
daily_hotel.author: Antigravity
en: Tom stands in front of the big hotel. It is a very beautiful building. The sun is bright today. Tom walks to the front door and opens it. He walks into the lobby. The lobby is quiet and clean. There are many chairs and big plants. A woman stands behind a large wooden desk. She is the receptionist. Tom walks to her and says, Hello. The woman looks at Tom and smiles. She says, Hello, welcome to our hotel. How are you today? Tom answers, I am very good, thank you. I have a reservation for tonight. My name is Tom Miller. The receptionist checks her computer carefully. She finds the name and nods. She says, Yes, Mr. Miller. We have your room. It is a nice room on the third floor.

Tom feels very happy. He gives his passport to the woman. She looks at the document and writes some information. Tom asks, Is breakfast included? The receptionist smiles and replies, Yes, breakfast is in the restaurant on the ground floor. It starts at seven o'clock in the morning. Tom nods and asks, What time is check-out? The woman says, Check-out is at eleven o'clock. Do you have any luggage? Tom points to his small blue suitcase. He says, Yes, I have one suitcase. The receptionist says, That is fine. Do you need help with your bags? Tom smiles and says, No, thank you. I can carry it. The woman gives a card to Tom. She says, This is your key. The room number is 302.

Tom takes the key card from the woman. He says, Thank you very much for your help. The receptionist says, You are welcome. Do you have more questions about the hotel? Tom thinks for a moment. He asks, Is there a swimming pool here? The woman points to the left. She says, Yes, the swimming pool is behind those glass doors. It is open until nine o'clock at night. You can go there for a swim. Tom says, That sounds great. I like to swim. The woman adds, You also have a gym next to the pool. Enjoy your stay at our hotel. Tom says, Thanks again. I want to go to my room now. He walks to the elevator. He is tired but happy. The hotel is perfect for his long trip.

Tom stands in front of the elevator. He presses the silver button. The door opens slowly. He walks inside the small metal box. He looks at the buttons on the wall. There are many numbers. He finds the number three and pushes it. The elevator moves up. He feels a little movement under his feet. The ride is very short. Soon, the elevator stops on the third floor. The door opens again. Tom walks into the quiet hallway. The carpet is soft and blue. He sees many doors with gold numbers. He walks slowly and looks for his room. He finds the door with the number 302. He is excited to see his room for the night. He stands in front of the door and takes his key card from his pocket.

He puts the plastic card into the machine on the door. A small green light flashes once. He hears a soft sound. The door unlocks for him. Tom pushes the door and walks into the room. It is very nice and clean. There is a large bed with white sheets in the middle. The sun shines through the big window. Tom puts his blue suitcase on the floor. He looks around the room with a smile. He sees a small desk and a chair in the corner. There is a television on the wall. The air is cool because of the air conditioner. Everything looks perfect for his visit. Tom feels tired after his long trip, but he is happy. He decides to sit on the bed for a few minutes.

The bed is very soft and comfortable. Tom takes off his shoes and relaxes. He thinks about the hotel and the friendly receptionist. He remembers the swimming pool and the gym. He wants to see them later today. Now, he checks the items in his room. He sees a small lamp on the bedside table. He checks the bathroom near the door. It is very clean and has white towels. He washes his hands and looks in the large mirror. He feels refreshed and ready to see the city. He needs to find some water to drink. He looks at the small fridge under the desk. He opens it and finds two bottles of cold water. This is a very good hotel. He is glad to be here today.

Tom stands up from the soft bed. He feels hungry and wants to find some food. He remembers the receptionist at the front desk. She is very helpful and kind. Tom decides to go back to the lobby. He walks to the door and opens it. He walks into the hallway and turns left. He sees the elevator again. He presses the silver button and waits for a few seconds. The door opens with a quiet sound. Tom steps inside and presses the lobby button. He likes the hotel because everything is easy to use. The elevator moves down slowly. He looks at the shiny wall in the elevator. He thinks about the restaurant in the hotel. He hopes they have good food. He wants to eat a nice lunch today.

The elevator arrives at the ground floor. Tom walks out of the elevator. The lobby is bright and quiet. He walks to the front desk. The receptionist sees him and smiles. Tom says, Hello again. She replies, Hello. How is your room? Tom says, My room is very nice and clean. Thank you. He asks, Is there a restaurant in this hotel? The receptionist nods her head. She points to a door on the right side of the lobby. She says, Yes, the restaurant is right there. It is open for lunch now. They have soup, salads, and sandwiches. Tom smiles at her. He is happy to hear this news. He thanks the lady for her help. He is ready to have a good meal now.

Tom walks toward the restaurant door. He is happy because he is very hungry. He sees a menu on a stand near the entrance. The food looks delicious and fresh. He looks at the prices and they are good. He walks inside the restaurant. A waiter meets him at the door. The waiter asks, Table for one? Tom answers, Yes, please. The waiter shows him a small table near a window. The chair is comfortable and the room smells like fresh coffee. Tom sits down and opens the menu. He looks at the choices carefully. He chooses a sandwich and a cold drink. He waits for his food and looks out of the window. The city is busy and beautiful. Tom enjoys his time in this quiet place.

Tom eats his lunch slowly. The sandwich is very good and the bread is soft. He finishes his cold drink. He feels full and happy now. He thinks about the afternoon. He wants to know more about the hotel. He remembers his question about the swimming pool. He finishes his meal and pays the bill. The waiter smiles and says thank you. Tom stands up and walks out of the restaurant. He walks back to the front desk. The receptionist is still there. She is a very kind woman. Tom walks to the desk and says hello. She smiles at him. Tom says, The lunch is delicious. Thank you for the tip. She nods and says, I am happy you like it. Is there anything else I can do for you today, Tom?

Tom smiles and asks his next question. He wants to swim in the water. He asks, Is there a swimming pool in this hotel? The receptionist looks at her computer. She answers, Yes, we have a beautiful pool on the top floor. It is very quiet and clean. You can take the elevator to the fifth floor. Tom says, That is great news. I love swimming. She continues, The pool is open until nine o'clock at night. You can find clean towels near the door. Tom says, Thank you so much for your help. She replies, You are very welcome. Enjoy your swim, Tom. He feels excited now. He likes this hotel because the staff is very helpful. He walks to the elevator again. He is ready for a long swim in the blue water.

The elevator door opens and Tom walks inside. He presses the button for the fifth floor. The elevator goes up quickly. He feels happy and relaxed. He thinks about the cool water in the pool. The elevator stops and the door opens. He walks out into the hallway. He sees a sign for the pool. He walks to the door and opens it. The room is big and bright. There are many blue chairs near the water. The pool looks perfect. Tom puts his bag on a chair. He walks to the edge of the water. He tests the temperature with his hand. It feels warm and nice. He gets ready to jump in. He is happy to stay at this hotel. Everything is perfect for his relaxing day today.

Tom jumps into the water. He swims slowly and feels very good. The water is clean and very calm. He enjoys the quiet atmosphere of the pool. After a long swim, he gets out of the pool and dries his body with a big white towel. He feels fresh and energetic now. He looks at the large windows in the room. He sees the beautiful city view from the fifth floor. It is a sunny afternoon and the sky is blue. Tom sits on a chair near the window. He feels very relaxed and happy in this place. He remembers his check-in time and his comfortable room. He loves this hotel because everything is easy to find. The staff members are very helpful and friendly to all the guests.

He packs his small bag and leaves the pool area. He walks back to the elevator and goes down to the lobby. The hotel lobby is bright and full of flowers. He walks to the front desk to say goodbye to the receptionist before he goes to his room. She looks up and smiles when she sees him. Tom says, The pool is wonderful, thank you for the information. She replies, I am glad you enjoy it, Tom. Do you need anything else before the evening? Tom says, No, everything is perfect. I want to rest in my room now. Have a nice afternoon. She smiles and says, Thank you, enjoy your rest in your room. See you later tonight, Tom. He feels very satisfied with his stay.

Tom walks to his room and opens the door. The room is quiet and the bed looks very soft. He puts his bag on the floor and lies down on the bed. He thinks about his day. The hotel is excellent and the service is great. He knows he has a good bed and a very nice room for the night. He closes his eyes and rests for a few minutes. He feels calm and peaceful. The hotel staff makes him feel safe and welcome here. He is ready for a good sleep tonight. He smiles to himself because he likes this trip very much. Tomorrow is a new day with new things to do. Tom sleeps peacefully in his clean and very comfortable hotel room.

Şehir kalabalık ve güzeldir. Tom bu sessiz yerdeki zamanının tadını çıkarır.

daily_park.title: Meeting in the Park
daily_park.author: Antigravity
en: It is a beautiful sunny morning. The sky is blue and the trees are green. Ben walks in the big park. He sees a bench near the tall trees. A woman sits on the bench. She reads a book. Ben smiles and walks to her. He says, Hello. The woman looks up and smiles. She says, Hello. I am Sarah. What is your name? Ben says, I am Ben. It is a nice day, Sarah. Sarah says, Yes, it is a very nice day. The park is very quiet today. Ben sits on the bench. He is happy to be in the park. The sun is warm on his face. He likes the fresh air. It is a good start for a nice day.

Sarah looks at Ben. She asks, Do you like this park? Ben nods and answers, Yes, I like it a lot. I walk here every morning. It is a good place to relax. Sarah closes her book. She says, I like this park too. I walk here with my dog sometimes. Today my dog is at home. Ben says, That is nice. I live near the park. I walk here for exercise. I enjoy the trees and the flowers. The park has many pretty colors. Sarah says, I agree. Everything looks very beautiful in the sun. They sit together and look at the flowers. A small bird flies near the bench. They watch the bird. The park is a peaceful and happy place for everyone today.

Ben looks at the grass. He says, Do you have a hobby, Sarah? Sarah smiles and says, Yes, I read books every day. I also like to draw pictures of flowers. What about you, Ben? Ben answers, I like to play soccer. I play with my friends on Saturdays. I also like to listen to music. Music makes me happy. Sarah says, That is great. I love music too. We have many hobbies. Ben says, Yes, hobbies are fun. It is good to have things we like. The sun is very bright now. They continue to talk on the bench. They learn new things about each other. It is a nice meeting. They are happy to talk and enjoy the bright sun in the park together.

Ben looks at the green grass and the tall trees around the park. He feels happy because the weather is very nice today. He asks Sarah, Do you like to listen to music in the park? Sarah smiles and answers, Yes, I like music very much. Sometimes I listen to calm music while I read my book. Do you play an instrument, Ben? Ben shakes his head and says, No, I do not play an instrument. I only listen to songs on my phone. Music is great for the soul. Sarah nods and says, I agree with you completely. Music makes the world a better place. They sit quietly for a few minutes and enjoy the sound of the wind in the trees. It is a very peaceful moment for both of them.

Sarah looks at her watch and then at the clear blue sky. She says, I have a hobby, I like to take photos of the flowers here. Do you like photography? Ben thinks for a moment and replies, I do not take many photos, but I like to look at them. Your hobby is very interesting. Sarah smiles and takes her camera from her bag. She shows a picture of a red flower to Ben. Ben says, Wow, this is a beautiful picture! You are a very good photographer. Sarah feels happy and says, Thank you, Ben. I enjoy capturing the colors of nature. The park has many pretty flowers today. They look at the photos together and talk about the different colors of the petals.

The sun is now high in the sky and it feels warm on their faces. Ben says, I like to run in the park on weekends. It is good for my health. Sarah says, That is a great habit. I prefer to walk slowly and enjoy the fresh air. Do you want to walk with me later? Ben smiles and says, Yes, that sounds like a lovely idea. I like to meet new people in the park. Sarah stands up and stretches her arms. She says, The park is my favorite place in the city. We learn many things today. Ben agrees and says, Yes, it is a very good day for a meeting. They decide to walk to the flower garden together and continue their nice conversation.

Ben and Sarah walk slowly on the path. The sun shines brightly and the air is warm. They see many people in the park today. Some people play games, and some people sit on the benches. Ben looks at a group of children. The children run and laugh together. Ben says to Sarah, The children are very happy today. Sarah smiles and nods her head. She says, Yes, they enjoy the beautiful weather. I like to see happy people here. They walk past a small fountain. The water is clear and cool. Ben asks, Do you come to this park every weekend? Sarah answers, Yes, I come here every Saturday. It is my favorite place to relax and walk. They continue their walk and talk about the trees and the birds in the park.

They stop near a large oak tree. Ben sits on a wooden bench. He says, It is a very nice day to be outside. Sarah sits next to him. She says, I agree. The park is very big and clean. Do you like sports? Ben nods and replies, Yes, I like to play football with my friends. I also like to run in the morning. What about you, Sarah? Sarah laughs softly. She says, I do not like sports very much. I prefer to walk or to draw pictures. I have a sketchbook in my bag. I like to draw the trees. Ben looks at her bag with interest. He says, Drawing is a very creative hobby. Can I see your drawings one day? Sarah smiles and says, Yes, of course. Maybe tomorrow.

The wind blows gently through the green leaves. Everything feels calm and peaceful. Ben looks at his watch. It is time for him to go home. He says, I have a great time today, Sarah. Thank you for the nice conversation. Sarah stands up and waves her hand. She says, Thank you too, Ben. It is very nice to meet you. Ben says, Do you want to meet here next week? Sarah answers, Yes, that is a great idea. I am free next Saturday morning. Ben says, Good, I see you then. They say goodbye and walk in different directions. Ben feels very happy. He likes his new friend. He walks out of the park and thinks about their next meeting under the big tree.

Ben walks back home. He sees a man with a guitar. The man sits under a tree and plays a song. The music is very soft and beautiful. Ben stops to listen for a moment. He likes the sound of the guitar. Many people walk by and smile at the man. Ben thinks about his time with Sarah in the park today. He feels happy and relaxed. The sun is now lower in the sky. He walks slowly and enjoys the warm wind on his face. He likes the park very much because he meets a new friend there. The trees are tall and the flowers are colorful. Ben says to himself, It is a good day. He walks home and thinks about his sketchbook hobby. Maybe he can draw too.

Sarah walks in the opposite direction. She sees a small cat near a bush. The cat is white and very fluffy. Sarah stops and says hello to the cat. The cat looks at her and makes a sound. She laughs and continues her walk on the path. She remembers her conversation with Ben. He is a very kind person. She likes his interest in her drawings. She thinks, I hope he likes my sketchbook next week. Sarah sees a woman with a camera. The woman takes a picture of a bird. Everything is calm and very quiet now. The sky turns a little bit orange. It is a perfect afternoon for a walk. She feels very happy about her new friend in the park today.

Both Ben and Sarah think about the park. They like the quiet moments and the fresh air. Next week they meet again under the big oak tree. They plan to talk more about their favorite hobbies. Ben wants to tell Sarah about his football games. Sarah wants to show him her nice drawings of the park. It is important to have good friends who enjoy the same places. The park is a special place for them now. They enjoy the simple things like the sun and the trees. They look forward to next Saturday. The city is busy, but the park is peaceful. They feel ready for their next meeting. It is a wonderful day to be outside and to meet new people.

The golden sun starts to go down behind the tall buildings near the park. Ben walks through the gate and waves at the park guard. He remembers his time with Sarah. He smiles because he has a new friend now. The park is quiet and peaceful. Ben walks home and sees a big tree. He sits on a wooden bench for a short time. He opens his bag and finds his pencils. He wants to draw the park today. He looks at the green grass and the beautiful flowers. A bird sings a song in the tree. Ben feels very happy. He likes his quiet hobby. He thinks about Sarah and her lovely drawings. They share a good time today. It is a nice day for everyone in this big city.

Sarah walks to her home slowly. She feels the light wind on her face. She sees many people on the street. Some people walk dogs and others talk with friends. Sarah likes the park because it is a special place for her. She talks to herself and says, I am happy today. She plans her drawings for the next meeting. She wants to show Ben her art book. The sky is now dark blue. The stars appear one by one. She thinks about the next Saturday. She waits for the day with a big smile. She loves the trees and the fresh air in the park. It is a perfect afternoon. She feels calm and her heart is very light.

Ben and Sarah look forward to their next meeting. They live near the park and they go there often. They enjoy the simple things like the wind and the trees. They are happy to meet new people. The park is a busy place but they find quiet spots. Next Saturday is a good time for them. They have many things to say to each other. They talk about their hobbies and their lives. They know that good friends are important. They say goodbye to the sun as it sets. The park is a home for their new friendship. They walk home with joy in their hearts. Everything is perfect. They wait for the next time in the beautiful and green park.
tr: Güzel ve güneşli bir sabah. Gökyüzü mavi ve ağaçlar yeşil. Ben büyük parkta yürüyor. Uzun ağaçların yanında bir bank görüyor. Bir kadın bankta oturuyor. Kitap okuyor. Ben gülümsüyor ve ona doğru yürüyor. Merhaba diyor. Kadın başını kaldırıyor ve gülümsüyor. Merhaba diyor. Ben Sarah. Senin adın ne? Ben diyor ki, Ben Ben. Bugün güzel bir gün, Sarah. Sarah diyor ki, Evet, çok güzel bir gün. Park bugün çok sessiz. Ben banka oturuyor. Parkta olduğu için mutlu. Güneş yüzünde sıcak. Taze havayı seviyor. Güzel bir gün için iyi bir başlangıç.

Sarah Ben'e bakıyor. Soruyor, Bu parkı seviyor musun? Ben başını sallıyor ve cevap veriyor, Evet, çok seviyorum. Her sabah burada yürüyorum. Dinlenmek için iyi bir yer. Sarah kitabını kapatıyor. O da diyor ki, Ben de bu parkı seviyorum. Bazen köpeğimle burada yürüyorum. Bugün köpeğim evde. Ben diyor ki, Bu güzel. Parkın yakınında yaşıyorum. Egzersiz için burada yürüyorum. Ağaçlardan ve çiçeklerden keyif alıyorum. Parkın çok güzel renkleri var. Sarah diyor ki, Katılıyorum. Güneşin altında her şey çok güzel görünüyor. Birlikte oturuyorlar ve çiçeklere bakıyorlar. Küçük bir kuş bankın yakınına uçuyor. Kuşu izliyorlar. Park bugün herkes için huzurlu ve mutlu bir yer.

Ben çimlere bakıyor. Soruyor, Bir hobin var mı, Sarah? Sarah gülümsüyor ve diyor ki, Evet, her gün kitap okurum. Ayrıca çiçek resimleri çizmeyi de seviyorum. Ya sen, Ben? Ben cevap veriyor, Futbol oynamayı seviyorum. Cumartesi günleri arkadaşlarımla oynuyorum. Ayrıca müzik dinlemeyi de severim. Müzik beni mutlu eder. Sarah diyor ki, Bu harika. Ben de müziği severim. Birçok hobimiz var. Ben diyor ki, Evet, hobiler eğlencelidir. Sevdiğimiz şeylere sahip olmak iyidir. Güneş şimdi çok parlak. Bankta konuşmaya devam ediyorlar. Birbirleri hakkında yeni şeyler öğreniyorlar. Güzel bir karşılaşma oldu. Birlikte konuşmaktan ve parktaki parlak güneşin tadını çıkarmaktan mutlular.

Ben parkın etrafındaki yeşil çimlere ve uzun ağaçlara bakıyor. Hava bugün çok güzel olduğu için mutlu hissediyor. Sarah'ya soruyor, Parkta müzik dinlemeyi sever misin? Sarah gülümsüyor ve cevap veriyor, Evet, müziği çok severim. Bazen kitabımı okurken sakin müzikler dinlerim. Sen bir enstrüman çalıyor musun, Ben? Ben başını iki yana sallıyor ve diyor ki, Hayır, enstrüman çalmıyorum. Sadece telefonumdan şarkılar dinliyorum. Müzik ruh için harikadır. Sarah başını sallıyor ve diyor ki, Sana kesinlikle katılıyorum. Müzik dünyayı daha iyi bir yer yapar. Birkaç dakika sessizce oturuyorlar ve ağaçlardaki rüzgarın sesinin tadını çıkarıyorlar. İkisi için de çok huzurlu bir an.

Sarah saatine bakıyor ve sonra açık mavi gökyüzüne çeviriyor gözlerini. Diyor ki, Bir hobim var, buradaki çiçeklerin fotoğraflarını çekmeyi seviyorum. Fotoğrafçılığı sever misin? Ben bir an düşünüyor ve cevap veriyor, Çok fazla fotoğraf çekmem ama onlara bakmayı severim. Hobin çok ilginç. Sarah gülümsüyor ve çantasından kamerasını çıkarıyor. Ben'e kırmızı bir çiçeğin resmini gösteriyor. Ben diyor ki, Vay canına, bu çok güzel bir fotoğraf! Sen çok iyi bir fotoğrafçısın. Sarah mutlu hissediyor ve diyor ki, Teşekkür ederim, Ben. Doğanın renklerini yakalamaktan keyif alıyorum. Parkta bugün çok güzel çiçekler var. Birlikte fotoğraflara bakıyorlar ve taç yaprakların farklı renkleri hakkında konuşuyorlar.

Güneş artık gökyüzünde yüksekte ve yüzlerinde sıcak hissediliyor. Ben diyor ki, Hafta sonları parkta koşmayı severim. Sağlığım için iyi. Sarah diyor ki, Bu harika bir alışkanlık. Ben yavaş yürümeyi ve temiz havanın tadını çıkarmayı tercih ediyorum. Daha sonra benimle yürümek ister misin? Ben gülümsüyor ve diyor ki, Evet, bu harika bir fikir gibi geliyor. Parkta yeni insanlarla tanışmayı severim. Sarah ayağa kalkıyor ve kollarını esnetiyor. Diyor ki, Park bu şehirdeki en sevdiğim yer. Bugün pek çok şey öğrendik. Ben onaylıyor ve diyor ki, Evet, tanışmak için çok güzel bir gün. Birlikte çiçek bahçesine yürümeye ve güzel sohbetlerine devam etmeye karar veriyorlar.

Ben ve Sarah yolda yavaşça yürüyorlar. Güneş parlak bir şekilde parlıyor ve hava sıcak. Bugün parkta birçok insan görüyorlar. Bazı insanlar oyun oynuyor, bazıları ise banklarda oturuyor. Ben bir grup çocuğa bakıyor. Çocuklar koşuyor ve birlikte gülüyorlar. Ben, Sarah'ya 'Çocuklar bugün çok mutlular' diyor. Sarah gülümsüyor ve başını sallıyor. 'Evet, güzel havanın tadını çıkarıyorlar. Burada mutlu insanlar görmeyi seviyorum' diyor. Küçük bir çeşmenin yanından geçiyorlar. Su berrak ve serin. Ben, 'Bu parka her hafta sonu geliyor musun?' diye soruyor. Sarah, 'Evet, her cumartesi buraya geliyorum. Burası dinlenmek ve yürümek için en sevdiğim yer' diye cevap veriyor. Yürüyüşlerine devam ediyorlar ve parktaki ağaçlar ile kuşlar hakkında konuşuyorlar.

Büyük bir meşe ağacının yanında duruyorlar. Ben ahşap bir banka oturuyor. 'Dışarıda olmak için çok güzel bir gün' diyor. Sarah yanına oturuyor. 'Katılıyorum. Park çok büyük ve temiz. Sporu sever misin?' diyor. Ben başını sallıyor ve 'Evet, arkadaşlarımla futbol oynamayı seviyorum. Ayrıca sabahları koşmayı da severim. Ya sen Sarah?' diye karşılık veriyor. Sarah hafifçe gülüyor. 'Spordan pek hoşlanmam. Yürümeyi veya resim çizmeyi tercih ederim. Çantamda bir eskiz defterim var. Ağaçları çizmeyi seviyorum' diyor. Ben merakla çantasına bakıyor. 'Resim çizmek çok yaratıcı bir hobi. Bir gün çizimlerini görebilir miyim?' diyor. Sarah gülümsüyor ve 'Evet, tabii ki. Belki yarın' diyor.

Rüzgar yeşil yaprakların arasından nazikçe esiyor. Her şey sakin ve huzurlu hissettiriyor. Ben saatine bakıyor. Eve gitme vakti geliyor. 'Bugün çok güzel vakit geçirdim Sarah. Güzel sohbetin için teşekkürler' diyor. Sarah ayağa kalkıyor ve el sallıyor. 'Ben de teşekkür ederim Ben. Seninle tanışmak çok güzeldi' diyor. Ben, 'Haftaya burada buluşalım mı?' diye soruyor. Sarah, 'Evet, bu harika bir fikir. Gelecek cumartesi sabahı boşum' diye cevap veriyor. Ben, 'İyi, o zaman görüşürüz' diyor. Vedalaşıp farklı yönlere yürüyorlar. Ben çok mutlu hissediyor. Yeni arkadaşını seviyor. Parktan çıkıyor ve büyük ağacın altındaki bir sonraki buluşmalarını düşünüyor.

Ben eve doğru geri yürür. Bir gitar tutan bir adam görür. Adam bir ağacın altında oturur ve bir şarkı çalar. Müzik çok hafif ve güzeldir. Ben bir anlığına dinlemek için durur. Gitarın sesini sever. Birçok insan yanından geçer ve adama gülümser. Ben, bugün parkta Sarah ile geçirdiği zamana dair düşünür. Kendini mutlu ve rahatlamış hisseder. Güneş artık gökyüzünde daha alçaktadır. Yavaşça yürür ve yüzündeki ılık rüzgarın keyfini çıkarır. Parkı çok sever çünkü orada yeni bir arkadaşla tanışmıştır. Ağaçlar uzundur ve çiçekler renklidir. Ben kendi kendine, bugün güzel bir gün der. Eve yürür ve eskiz defteri hobisi hakkında düşünür. Belki o da çizebilir.

Sarah zıt yöne doğru yürür. Bir çalının yanında küçük bir kedi görür. Kedi beyaz ve çok tüylüdür. Sarah durur ve kediye merhaba der. Kedi ona bakar ve bir ses çıkarır. O güler ve yoldaki yürüyüşüne devam eder. Ben ile yaptığı konuşmayı hatırlar. O çok kibar bir insandır. Onun çizimlerine olan ilgisini beğenir. Haftaya eskiz defterimi beğenmesini umuyorum diye düşünür. Sarah kameralı bir kadın görür. Kadın bir kuşun fotoğrafını çeker. Her yer şimdi sakin ve çok sessizdir. Gökyüzü biraz turuncuya döner. Yürüyüş için mükemmel bir öğleden sonrasıdır. Bugün parktaki yeni arkadaşı hakkında çok mutlu hisseder.

Hem Ben hem de Sarah park hakkında düşünürler. Sessiz anları ve temiz havayı severler. Gelecek hafta büyük meşe ağacının altında tekrar buluşurlar. En sevdikleri hobileri hakkında daha fazla konuşmayı planlarlar. Ben, Sarah'ya futbol maçlarını anlatmak ister. Sarah ona parkın güzel çizimlerini göstermek ister. Aynı yerlerden hoşlanan iyi arkadaşlara sahip olmak önemlidir. Park artık onlar için özel bir yerdir. Güneş ve ağaçlar gibi basit şeylerin keyfini çıkarırlar. Gelecek cumartesiyi iple çekerler. Şehir meşguldür ama park huzurludur. Bir sonraki buluşmaları için hazır hissederler. Dışarıda olmak ve yeni insanlarla tanışmak için harika bir gündür.

Altın güneş parkın yanındaki yüksek binaların arkasında batmaya başlar. Ben kapıdan geçer ve park bekçisine el sallar. Sarah ile geçirdiği zamanı hatırlar. Artık yeni bir arkadaşı olduğu için gülümser. Park sessiz ve huzurludur. Ben evine yürür ve büyük bir ağaç görür. Kısa bir süre için ahşap bir banka oturur. Çantasını açar ve kalemlerini bulur. Bugün parkı çizmek ister. Yeşil çimlere ve güzel çiçeklere bakar. Bir kuş ağaçta şarkı söyler. Ben kendini çok mutlu hisseder. Sessiz hobisini sever. Sarah'yı ve onun güzel çizimlerini düşünür. Bugün iyi vakit geçirdiler. Bu büyük şehirde herkes için güzel bir gün.

Sarah evine yavaşça yürür. Hafif rüzgarı yüzünde hisseder. Sokakta birçok insan görür. Bazı insanlar köpeklerini gezdirir, bazıları ise arkadaşlarıyla konuşur. Sarah parkı sever çünkü orası onun için özel bir yerdir. Kendi kendine konuşur ve bugün mutluyum der. Bir sonraki buluşma için çizimlerini planlar. Ben'e sanat kitabını göstermek ister. Gökyüzü artık koyu mavidir. Yıldızlar tek tek belirir. Gelecek cumartesiyi düşünür. Kocaman bir gülümsemeyle o günü bekler. Parktaki ağaçları ve temiz havayı sever. Mükemmel bir öğleden sonradır. Sakin hisseder ve kalbi çok hafiftir.

Ben ve Sarah bir sonraki buluşmalarını iple çekerler. Parkın yakınında otururlar ve oraya sık sık giderler. Rüzgar ve ağaçlar gibi basit şeylerden keyif alırlar. Yeni insanlarla tanıştıkları için mutludurlar. Park kalabalık bir yerdir ama onlar sessiz köşeler bulurlar. Gelecek cumartesi onlar için iyi bir zamandır. Birbirlerine söyleyecekleri çok şey vardır. Hobileri ve hayatları hakkında konuşurlar. İyi arkadaşların önemli olduğunu bilirler. Güneş batarken ona veda ederler. Park, yeni arkadaşlıkları için bir yuvadır. Kalplerinde sevinçle eve yürürler. Her şey mükemmeldir. Güzel ve yeşil parkta geçirecekleri bir sonraki zamanı beklerler.

daily_library.title: Finding a Book
daily_library.author: Antigravity
en: The sun is bright today. It is a very nice day. Anna walks on the street. She sees a big building. It is the city library. Anna wants a book about animals. She likes animals very much. She enters the library. The library is quiet and cool. Many people sit at tables. They read books or look at computers. Anna walks to the front desk. A friendly man sits there. He smiles at Anna. Anna says, Hello. I want a book about animals. Where are the animal books? The man points to the back of the room. He says, The animal books are in row five. They are near the window. Anna says, Thank you very much. She is happy to find the books. She walks slowly to the back of the library.

Anna walks between the tall shelves. She looks at the labels on the shelves. One shelf has a sign. It says Science. Another shelf has a sign. It says History. Anna walks to row five. She sees many books there. Some books are thin and some are very thick. She looks at the covers. She sees pictures of lions, tigers, and bears. She picks up a thin book. It has a picture of a cute cat on the front cover. She likes this book. She also sees a big book about elephants. She likes this book too. It is difficult to choose just one book today. She holds two books in her hands. She smiles because she finds good stories. The library is a great place to be.

Anna walks back to the front desk. The man is still there. He works on his computer. Anna puts the two books on the desk. She wants to borrow them. She says, I want these two books, please. The man looks at the books. He says, Do you have a library card? Anna says, Yes, I have my card here. She opens her bag and takes out a small card. The man takes the card and scans it. He also scans the books. He says, You can keep these books for two weeks. Anna says, Thank you. You are very kind. The man says, You are welcome. Please enjoy your reading. Anna takes her books and her card. She walks to the door. She is ready to go home and read.

Anna walks between the tall wooden shelves. She looks for the signs on the rows. She sees a row with a sign that says Nature. She stops and looks at the many books there. The books have nice colors like blue, red, and green. Anna is very happy. She touches a book with a picture of a bird on it. It looks interesting. Then she looks at another shelf. There is a small blue book about dogs. She picks up the book and looks at the pages. The pages are clean and white. She reads the back of the book. It says that dogs are good friends. Anna likes this book a lot. She thinks it is the perfect book for her today. She holds the book in her hand and smiles at it.

A lady walks near Anna. She is another librarian. Anna asks her a simple question about the books. Anna says, Excuse me, do you have more books about cats? The librarian smiles at Anna and says, Yes, we have many books about cats in row six. It is right behind this row. Anna says, Thank you for your help. The librarian says, You are welcome. Anna walks to row six very slowly. She looks at the titles on the books. She finds a red book with a kitten on the cover. The book is very pretty. She takes the red book from the shelf. Now she has two books in her hands. She likes these books very much. She wants to take them home to read them today.

Anna walks back to the front of the library. She wants to talk to the man at the desk again. The man is busy with his computer, but he sees Anna. He stops and looks at her. Anna puts the two books on the big desk. The man looks at the books and says, These are good choices. Anna says, Thank you. I like animals very much. The man smiles and asks, Do you have your library card today? Anna says, Yes, I have it. She takes her blue card out of her small bag. She gives the card to the man. The man puts the card in his machine. He works very fast. Anna waits quietly. She feels very excited to start her reading at home.

The man takes the blue card from Anna. He puts it in a small machine on the desk. The machine makes a little sound. It shows a green light. Anna watches the man carefully. He clicks the buttons on his computer screen. The man looks at Anna and smiles at her. He says, You have a good library card. It is ready to use now. Anna feels very happy. She nods her head and smiles back at him. The man puts the two books on the desk near the computer. He picks up one book and then the other book. He scans the back of every book. Everything is fast and easy. The library is a nice place for her today. She likes the quiet room and the friendly people who work here.

The librarian says, You can keep these books for two weeks. Do you have a bag for the books? Anna shakes her head. She says, No, I do not have a bag. The man opens a drawer in his desk. He pulls out a large paper bag. He puts the red book and the blue book inside the bag. Then he gives the bag to Anna. Anna says, Thank you for your help. The man says, You are welcome. Please come back soon to find more books. Anna takes the bag and walks to the big door of the library. She holds the bag tight. She feels very happy because she has new stories to read at home. She walks outside and feels the warm sun on her face.

Anna walks home on the sidewalk. She holds her bag with the two library books. She thinks about the dog in the blue book and the cat in the red book. She wants to sit in her comfortable chair and read them. The library is not far from her house. She sees her house and opens the front door. She goes inside and puts her bag on the table. She takes the books out of the bag. The cat book is very soft in her hands. The dog book is very colorful. She sits on her chair and opens the first page. The words are big and easy to read. Anna begins her new story. She is happy and ready for a good time with her books.

Anna sits in her quiet room. The sun shines through the window. It is a nice afternoon for reading. She holds the red book. She turns the first page carefully. The pictures are beautiful and bright. She sees a small cat in the book. The cat plays with a ball of red wool. Anna likes this story very much. She reads every word slowly. She does not know all the words, but she understands the story well. The language is simple and clear. She smiles as she reads about the happy cat. It is fun to learn new things in this way. She spends a long time with her book. The room is very still. She loves this quiet time because it helps her learn new words and new stories.

After one hour, Anna puts the red book down. She picks up the blue book now. This book is about a big dog. The dog runs in the green grass. Anna likes the dog because he is very friendly. She looks at the drawings on the page. She talks to herself. She says, This dog is funny. She learns the word for grass and the word for run. She writes the words in her notebook. It is good practice for her. The book has many pages, but she is not tired. She reads page after page. The dog finds a bone under a tree. Anna laughs because it is a happy story. She feels smart today. Reading is a great way to spend the day at home.

The day ends and the sky turns orange. Anna finishes her books for today. She puts them on her wooden table. She feels proud of her work. She knows more English words now than she knows in the morning. The library is a very helpful place. She thinks about the librarian. He is a very kind man. She wants to go back to the library next week. There are many more books on the high shelves. She closes her eyes and remembers the stories. She thinks about the cat and the dog. She is ready for a good sleep. Tomorrow she wants to read the books again. She is thankful for the library. It is a wonderful day for a student like Anna.

The next week arrives and Anna walks to the city library. It is a sunny Monday morning. She carries her two books in a small bag. She enters the building and looks around. The library is very quiet and big. Many people sit at the tables. They read books or work on computers. Anna walks to the front desk. The kind librarian sees her and smiles. He says, Hello Anna, how are you today? Anna smiles back and says, Hello, I am very good, thank you. I finish my books. They are very nice stories. The librarian nods his head. He says, That is great news. Do you want to borrow more books? Anna says, Yes, please. I like to read more. I want to learn more English words. The librarian walks to the shelf with her.

They walk between the tall shelves. The shelves have many books with different colors. The librarian points to a blue shelf. He says, These books are for beginners. The stories are short and easy. Anna looks at the books. She picks up a green book. The title is The Happy Bird. She opens it and reads one page. She understands the words very well. She tells the librarian, This book is perfect for me. The librarian helps her with the next step. He says, Please give me your library card. Anna takes her card from her pocket. She gives it to him. The librarian scans the card and the book. He says, You can keep this book for two weeks. Anna says, Thank you for your help today. You are very kind.

Anna puts the green book in her bag. She feels very happy now. She waves goodbye to the librarian. She walks out of the library into the warm sun. She walks home slowly because she wants to read on the way. She sits on a wooden bench in the park. She opens her green book and starts to read. A bird sings in the tree above her. It is a peaceful moment. She learns a new word today, and she feels proud. She knows that reading is the best way to learn a new language. She likes her new hobby very much. She looks at the sky and smiles. She knows she is a good student. The world of books is big and full of fun. She walks home to continue her story.
tr: Güneş bugün parlak. Çok güzel bir gün. Anna caddede yürüyor. Büyük bir bina görüyor. Burası şehir kütüphanesi. Anna hayvanlar hakkında bir kitap istiyor. Hayvanları çok seviyor. Kütüphaneye giriyor. Kütüphane sessiz ve serin. Birçok insan masalarda oturuyor. Kitap okuyorlar veya bilgisayarlara bakıyorlar. Anna danışma masasına yürüyor. Dost canlısı bir adam orada oturuyor. Anna'ya gülümsüyor. Anna, Merhaba, hayvanlarla ilgili bir kitap istiyorum. Hayvan kitapları nerede? diyor. Adam odanın arkasını gösteriyor. Hayvan kitapları beşinci sırada, pencerenin yanında diyor. Anna, Çok teşekkür ederim, diyor. Kitapları bulduğu için mutlu. Yavaşça kütüphanenin arkasına doğru yürüyor.

Anna uzun rafların arasında yürüyor. Raflardaki etiketlere bakıyor. Bir rafta bir tabela var. Bilim yazıyor. Başka bir rafta başka bir tabela var. Tarih yazıyor. Anna beşinci sıraya yürüyor. Orada birçok kitap görüyor. Bazı kitaplar ince, bazıları ise çok kalın. Kapaklara bakıyor. Aslan, kaplan ve ayı resimleri görüyor. İnce bir kitap alıyor. Ön kapağında sevimli bir kedi resmi var. Bu kitabı seviyor. Ayrıca filler hakkında büyük bir kitap görüyor. Bu kitabı da seviyor. Bugün sadece bir kitap seçmek zor. İki kitabı ellerinde tutuyor. İyi hikayeler bulduğu için gülümsüyor. Kütüphane olmak için harika bir yer.

Anna danışma masasına geri yürüyor. Adam hala orada. Bilgisayarı üzerinde çalışıyor. Anna iki kitabı masaya koyuyor. Onları ödünç almak istiyor. Kitapları alabilir miyim, lütfen? diyor. Adam kitaplara bakıyor. Kütüphane kartın var mı? diyor. Anna, Evet, kartım burada, diyor. Çantasını açıyor ve küçük bir kart çıkarıyor. Adam kartı alıyor ve tarıyor. Kitapları da tarıyor. Bu kitapları iki hafta boyunca tutabilirsin diyor. Anna, Teşekkür ederim. Çok naziksiniz, diyor. Adam, Rica ederim. Lütfen okumanın tadını çıkar, diyor. Anna kitaplarını ve kartını alıyor. Kapıya doğru yürüyor. Eve gidip okumaya hazır.
